theme: Steven Bonta partial decipherment, distributional fields, lexical chance and ICIT source history
question: Do PDF-identified field signs and proposed readings reproduce structural and lexical effects after accounting for dictionary-derived values and object reuse?
outcome: Exploratory first coding: 58 Table 18 assignments (55 plus AS/ISH/ASTI), 65 table drawings; 82 table/caption forms and 14 field targets give 96 mapping targets, 85 singleton Mayig, 3 ambiguous, 8 unmapped; Wells/Helsinki candidates for 88. Inventory: 1200 source rows, 859 attempts, 549 labels, 713 CISI-joined attempts, 338 object families; 33 joined source entries have qualifiers. Canonical fields: 942 clean, 349 conflict, 1178 indeterminate on 2469 objects; shuffle mean 419.87. Compound-aware fish adjacency 142 versus 55.72. Full lexical selection: 640 attempts, 84/228 exact types versus mean 27.83, tail .0005. Post-outcome explicit-caption sensitivity: 83/206 versus 28.75, tail .0005. Clear non-dictionary origins and fitted alternatives removed: 2/5 exact, tail 24/120=.20; normalized 3/5, tail 70/120=.5833. Unknown later-extension construction and zero identified historical held-out entries prevent out-of-sample validation. Earlier panel: all 13 normalized permutations scoring >=9 retain PU, none of 600 moving it reaches 9; 8/10 strings contain PU/PATI dictionary-derived against those contexts, making the tail close to circular; all nine observed hits are exact and normalization is broader than Table 18. Jar final 838/1196, 358 nonfinal, 241 followed by 400/090; arrow final 192/225, 33 nonfinal. Strong tendencies reproduce; categorical sequence-final form fails. PDF ICIT cohort: 68 labels, 48 joined, 8 confirmed MH links plus 1 questioned. Earlier audit retains 3 repeated objects (one ICIT-first, one MH-first alias, one iconography mention) and 3 parser false overlaps. Historical validation denominator and physical quantity joins (zero) remain unresolved. Ledger: 1021 rows; 90 retained rows updated, 32 new source claims and 859 reading annotations. All mapping-dependent results await independent coding.
challenge: Single-reader graphic mapping; damaged/unlabelled figure attachment; contextual field boundaries and wider Table 19 grammar; unknown lexical construction for 49 later-extension roles; missing historical check/failure list and fixed historical values; no independent quantity joins. Machine captions remain unchecked against audio; Kalyanaraman content remains unverified after HTTP 403.
remedy: Verified supplied PDF witness and page map; extracted local-only crops; froze two mapping versions before neutral packets and scoring; inventoried source attempts and explicit object joins; registered canonical fields and lexical tests; separated clear derivations and source-explicit post-outcome sensitivity; qualified questioned object aliases; retained frozen runs and all parser successors; prepared 96-target blind packet.
retry_when: Independent coding arrives for agreement/adjudication and new versioned reruns. Complete manual source attachment and broader field grammar. Obtain the historical ICIT attempt/failure list and pre-check values, or test externally reserved objects under fixed finite lexical rules. An inscription-specific metrology test requires an independent physical quantity join; direct earlier-edition collation requires accessible witnesses.
